{{Quote|Black Sun ''might'' be looking for us, but it's a big sector.|[[Cade Skywalker]], while on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]|<ref name="Legacy37" />}}
The '''Arkanis sector''' was a sector located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Planets in this sector included [[Andooweel/Legends|Andooweel]], [[C-Foroon]], [[Sirpar/Legends|Sirpar]], [[Arkanis/Legends|Arkanis]], [[Najiba/Legends|Najiba]], [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], [[Piroket/Legends|Piroket]] and [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==History==
[[File:Arkanis_sector_EAOC.jpg|thumb|left|215px|The Arkanis sector and its surrounding [[Sector/Legends|sectors]]]]
The Arkanis sector had been a crossroads for traders and travelers. It was bordered by the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] which many used to travel from the Core Worlds to the Outer Rim and Wild Space. It was also crossed by the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]], which led into Hutt Space.<ref name="TEA" /> A subset of the sector were the [[Regency Worlds/Legends|Regency Worlds]], a relatively prosperous region on the Corellian Run formed around the former Arkanis Regency. Unfortunately, this prosperity rarely extended to other parts of the sector, with only a mild boost in trade (and a significant one in crime) as Hutt interests moved in towards the end of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]].

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], after [[Battle of Teth/Legends|rescuing]] and [[Mission to Jabba's Palace (Clone Wars)/Legends|returning]] [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]] to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] allowed the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Clone Army]] to pass through the Arkanis sector, as well as the neighboring [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], unlike the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]].

During [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] rule, it was governed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Alexander Julstan IV]].<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref> At some point before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the Empire had retreated its [[Arkanis sector fleet|fleet]] from the sector, ceding ''de facto'' control over the sector to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="SS" />

[[Nieve Gromia]] was a later [[Moff/Legends|moff]] of the sector following the [[Sith–Imperial War]].

{{Sec-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The "Arkonis sector" appears once in the [[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'' novel]] as the location of the Devastator when Darth Vader receives a transmission alerting him to Divini's messages on the MedNet regarding midi-chlorians prior to traveling to the [[Toprawa system/Legends|Toprawa system]]. It is unknown whether this is a misspelling of "Arkanis sector". It also bears noting that according to the novel, Arkonis sector is located in the Outer Rim while Arkanis sector (in contradiction to previous and later sources) is said to be located in Wild Space. On pages 251 and 263 of the hardcover edition of Death Star, the region in which Tatooine and the Arkanis sector are located is stated to be Wild Space. This also contradicts previous and later sources which establish the Outer Rim Territories as the region in which Tatooine and the Arkanis sector were located. The "Arkonis sector" does not appear in the later published ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', its associated maps, or the supplemental [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]].
